item.title: security: The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane
item.description:
Microsoft Security says organizations need protection that works between vulnerability discovery and remediation, because the patch window is shrinking. The post argues for a new security control plane to cover that gap.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
